correctness.rationale: For n≥3, exchangeability separates disagreement probabilities d1 (founder vs nonfounder) and d2 (two nonfounders), satisfying (n−1)d1′=−n d1+(n−2)d2 and (n−1)d2′=2d1−4d2. Time-integrating with boundary zero gives ∫d1=2(n−1)/(n+2), the founder flip expectation. n=2 direct first exponential event gives 1/2, matching formula. Independently solved full 2^n-state transient generator for n=2..6; values 1/2,4/5,1,8/7,5/4 agree. The martingale fixation probability 1/n and pathwise D−U=1−1_all-one yield exact EU. Gambler-ruin chance 1/k to hit k before zero, plus Dynkin potential g(i)=(n−1)i(k−i)/(2(n−k)), bound P(U≥1)≤1/k+(k−1)/(2(n−k)). Choosing floor sqrt n gives N→1 in probability while EN→2 and EU/P(U≥1)≥(1/3+o(1))sqrt n. This is an upper bound on rare probability, not its asymptotic equivalence.
